bugs.summary: install.packages support installing dependencies as needed when installing local tarball
bugs.creator: gabembecker

comments.text:
Currently, the way to install  a package from local sources while in R is to do

```
install.packages("<local path>", repos = NULL)
```

This works if all the dependencies are already installed, but fails if they are not, while 'normal' package installation succeeds either way.

I propose `install.packages` support the local-source-needs-dependencies case.

One option would be to add a `local` argument which defaults to `is.null(repos)` (thus preserving existing behavior), and which controls whether `pkgs` should be interpreted as local paths.

Kurt Hornik suggested this can be implemented by creating a local package repository and adding it to any that are specified with the `repos` argument. 

Some care may be needed in cases where the package appears in the repos and the local version is lower than the repo version. 

I will work on preparing a patch at some point if no one gets to it first.
comments.creator: gabembecker
